title: Amish Agriculture: Harmony with Nature Through Animal Power
reason: Explains the Amish approach to farming, emphasizing their sustainable and community-focused practices.

tasks.task: Describe the Amish farming method that relies on animal power and natural processes.

subtasks.text: Observe the world's largest pumpkin on the Amish farm.
Note the contrast between the Amish's large pumpkin and tiny hand-sized pumpkins they use for specific purposes.

tasks.task: Explain the Amish philosophy of farming in harmony with nature.

subtasks.text: Highlight the use of hand tools and animal power for farm work.
Observe the rhythmic sound of hoofbeats, creaks of harnesses, and the voices of Amish farmers guiding their animals.

tasks.task: Describe the Amish practice of soil health and crop rotation.

subtasks.text: Watch Amish farmers carefully rotate crops to enrich the soil.
Notice the use of natural fertilizers like livestock manure and compost to maintain soil health.

tasks.task: Outline the Amish approach to pest management.

subtasks.text: Observe the use of companion planting with marigolds to repel harmful insects.
Notice the emphasis on biodiversity to create a healthier ecosystem.
